gold.title: The include_website_name method is missing the required ? suffix. Rails serializers expect include_ methods to end with
gold.description: The include_website_name method is missing the required ? suffix. Rails serializers expect include_ methods to end with ? for conditional attribute inclusion, a convention followed by other methods in this serializer. Without it, the website_name attribute may not be conditionally included as intended. Additionally, the '.' << website_host string concatenation should be replaced with '.' + website_host or '.#{website_host}' to avoid mutating string literals, which can lead to issues.

candidate.title: `include_website_name` is missing the trailing `?`, so it never runs
candidate.description: The method name should be `include_website_name?` to match ActiveModel::Serializers convention. As written, the method is dead code and `website_name` is emitted unconditionally.

promotion_candidates.title: `website_name` bypasses the `untrusted_attributes` gate that hides `website` from anonymous TL0 profiles
promotion_candidates.description: `untrusted_attributes` lists `:website` but not `:website_name`, so for a TL0 user viewed by an anonymous visitor, `website_name` is still serialized. The field is exposed in the JSON API and renders on the profile when it shouldn't.

promotion_candidates.title: Website in the profile header no longer updates after saving preferences
promotion_candidates.description: The removed `websiteName` computed property was reactive, but `User#save` doesn't copy `website_name` back from the response. A user who sets a website and saves sees it update but the website_name stays undefined until a full page reload.
